title: Ice Cream Truck (Baby Boo)
blurb: Tinny, slightly out of tune, and capable of commanding children across an entire postcode. The ice cream van jingle is a genuinely strange piece of audio design — it is meant to sound charming and instead sounds faintly haunted, particularly when heard at the wrong hour or fading down a distant street. That ambiguity is why it works in edits. Play it to trigger a Pavlovian childhood response in adults who thought they were over it, or simply to announce that treats have arrived and everybody should stop what they are doing.
origin: The classic ice cream truck jingle, viral as a nostalgia trigger.
